proposition.claim: Section 3.2, Eq. (4), PDF p. 6, forms a perturbation at the resized resolution and then upsamples that perturbation for transfer. Released optimize_image.py, lines 50–55, instead subtracts an upsampled optimized image from the original-resolution reference.

concern.description:
The released original-resolution extraction adds a resize residual absent from the paper's perturbation formula. It can attribute ordinary lost image detail to a watermark even without an optimization update.

Impact assessment. The current helper still adds the deterministic down/up-sampling residual absent from Eq. (4). Its demonstrated impact is a local resolution-handling mismatch, without measured watermark-decoder effects.
